SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_series.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(o.payment_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq.n DAY) AS `date` FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) seq WHERE seq.n < #{days} ) date_series LEFT JOIN tb_order o ON DATE(o.create_time) = date_series.date AND o.status != 4 AND o.deleted = 0 GROUP BY date_series.date ORDER BY date_series.date ASC

SELECT oi.product_id AS product_id, oi.product_name AS product_name, oi.product_image AS product_image, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_count, SUM(oi.total_price) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order_item oi INNER JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 4 AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.product_image ORDER BY sales_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_count, SUM(oi.total_price) AS sales_amount FROM tb_order_item oi INNER JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN tb_product p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN tb_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE o.status != 4 AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY p.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT CASE WHEN payment_amount < 100 THEN '0-100元' WHEN payment_amount < 500 THEN '100-500元' WHEN payment_amount < 1000 THEN '500-1000元' WHEN payment_amount < 3000 THEN '1000-3000元' WHEN payment_amount < 5000 THEN '3000-5000元' ELSE '5000元以上' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_order WHERE status != 4 AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(payment_amount)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_series.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(COUNT(u.id), 0) AS new_user_count FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq.n DAY) AS `date` FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) seq WHERE seq.n < #{days} ) date_series LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON DATE(u.create_time) = date_series.date AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY date_series.date ORDER BY date_series.date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_series.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(COUNT(r.id), 0) AS review_count FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq.n DAY) AS `date` FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) seq WHERE seq.n < #{days} ) date_series LEFT JOIN tb_review r ON DATE(r.create_time) = date_series.date AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 GROUP BY date_series.date ORDER BY date_series.date ASC
